# Replacement GameCube IPL fonts

`font_western.bin` (Windows-1252) and `font_japanese.bin` (Shift JIS) stand in for the fonts in
the console's boot ROM, which the SDK's `OSInitFont` reads. They are free fonts based on Droid
Sans (Apache License 2.0, see `LICENSE`), generated by the Dolphin project with its
`gc-font-tool` and taken unchanged from Dolphin's `Data/Sys/GC`.

A boot ROM dump in `user/IPL.bin` takes precedence (the original fonts have slightly different
metrics).
